notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics vendor evaluating Redwood. Started on Hosted API to validate model quality and integration velocity. POC showed quality and streaming nice, but hosted token costs and variable latency pushed them to ask about Dedicated reserved capacity.

POC observations and product asks:
- Workloads: ~200 qps peak for embeddings/rerank pipeline during index rebuilds; chat traffic ~35 qps steady, spiky during product launches.
- Latency goal: p95 chat < 120ms on 8k context when on Dedicated; currently hosted p95 ~240ms (short prompts) under POC synthetic load.
- Throughput: need autoscale burst + predictable throughput for index rebuild windows (8-12 hour windows).
- Cost target: reduce per-token cost by ~50% vs hosted POC to fit product roadmap economics.
- Model preferences: open LLaMA-like family acceptable; want Redwood-verified perf profile and recommended quantization.
- Routing/fallback: want policy to route warm sessions to Dedicated, fall back to Hosted for overflow.

Security / procurement asks (explicit):
- MSA/DPA redlines: liability cap, C2 data deletion within 30 days, retention controls configurable per-tenant, explicit DPA language for personal data, jurisdiction for disputes (CA).
- SLA: request 99.9% uptime for Dedicated, p95 latency SLO clause for inference < 120ms or credits; definition of downtime vs degraded performance.
- Vendor onboarding: require SOC2 Type II report, ISO27001 if available, pen-test summary, list of subprocessors, KMS BYOK support, audit_logs retention 12 months.
- Network: VPC peering + private egress, minimum TLS and cipher requirements documented.

Commercial / Pricing notes:
- They prefer a committed monthly spend with a defined burst allowance. Pricing team asked for a 12-mo reserved plan + overage rates.
- GlacierPoint indicated willingness to sign a 12–24 month commitment if SLA and DPA acceptable.

Quotes / paraphrases:
- "We need predictable unit economics before we can build this into core product." — Head of Product
- "If we can get Dedicated with those latency SLOs and BYOK, we can migrate chat and embeddings by Q3." — VP Eng

Open items and asks for Redwood team:
1) Legal: provide clean MSA + DPA and a redline-friendly comparison doc highlighting areas Redwood will consider (liability, deletion SLA, data residency).
2) SE: deliver Dedicated sizing worksheet (GPU slots, expected concurrency, expected tokens/day) by 2026-03-12.
3) Infra: confirm KMS BYOK timeline and how key rotation works with Dedicated.
4) Billing: sample committed pricing bands and example overage calculations for 12-mo term.

Next meeting: procurement call w/VP Eng and Legal scheduled tentatively for 2026-03-18 (confirm).

Notes style: shorthand. See linked drive pricing and security docs. Jira INF-7212 opened for KMS question.
